    error_type=getattr(httpx,error_name)

    if asynchronous:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler),trust_env=False) as client:

            with pytest.raises(error_type) as caught: await client.send(request)
    else:
        with httpx.Client(transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler),trust_env=False) as client:
            request=client.build_request('POST','http://case.invalid/records',content=b'input')
            with pytest.raises(error_type) as caught: client.send(request)
